mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) may potentiate allopurinol's effects and both drugs can affect hepatic metabolism; allopurinol may increase levels of other drugs metabolized by xanthine oxidase inhibition.
action: Monitor for enhanced allopurinol effects and adverse events; use with caution and consider dose adjustment of allopurinol if needed; monitor for signs of xanthine oxidase inhibition-related toxicity.
